identification: Framed oval pencil/charcoal portrait of a young woman, signed in pencil lower right 'Alice M. Atchison 1882' (catalogue reads Mary M.). Frame dark moulded with scroll pattern, 40x30 cm. Attributed to Alice M. Atchison, who exhibited a pencil drawing at the Intercolonial Juvenile Industrial Exhibition, Melbourne (NSW State Library PDF), so likely an amateur/juvenile work. The same drawing (same frame and image) appears on Invaluable passed in at Woodlands Auctions, Ocean Grove, 17 June 2026.

entries.note: Same drawing, lot 382, passed in, no price reached. Appears to be the same piece Armitage now has.
